id.what: the league's own player id with a source prefix (nba:<PERSON_ID>, nfl:<gsis_id>); never built from a name

name.what: the player's name as the league's roster publishes it

league.what: a professional league from the leagues list below

team.what: the team's name as the league publishes it

teamCity.what: the team's city as the league publishes it

arena.what: the team's home arena or stadium, by name

season.what: the season the team fields describe: 2025 or 2025-26

school.what: the school or college the league lists

birthCity.what: birthplace, city level: the city's name

birthRegion.what: birthplace: the state, province or region's name

sources.what: one entry per source read; together they cite every field the record carries

upstreamId.what: the record's id at that source (a Wikidata Q-id, a league id)

url.what: the https URL the fields were read from

retrievedAt.what: when it was read: ISO 8601 UTC ending in Z

fields.what: the record fields this source supplied

denied.why: Cam's never-list: birth date, age, addresses, family, contact details, health beyond league-published availability. A key that is not on the allowlist fails anyway; a key matching one of these fails with the code denied, so the reason is named.
